english.title: Bring animals / animal products / genetic material in breach of declaration to suspend / impose conditions on import

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) brought

(A)_[animals, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMALS..),]_
(B)_[products specified in Commission Decision 2007/275/EC, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCTS..),]_
(C)_[genetic material, namely **(..SPECIFY GENETIC MATERIAL..),]_

into England in breach of a written declaration made by the

(D)_[Secretary of State]_
(E)_[Food Standards Agency]_

(F)_[suspending]_
(G)_[imposing conditions, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITIONS BREACHED..), upon]_

the entry into England of any such

(H)_[animal]_
(I)_[product]_
(J)_[genetic material]_

from the whole or part of the country concerned, namely **(..SPECIFY THE COUNTRY OR PART OF COUNTRY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 29(4), 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
brought animals / products / genetic material into England in breach of declaration made by S of S / Food Standards Agency
suspending / imposing conditions upon entry into England of animal / product / genetic material
from the whole / part of the country concerned

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
